title: Rethinking Dual-Stream Super-Resolution Semantic Learning in Medical Image Segmentation (DS2F)
mechanism: Shows DSRL feature affinity is too weak for small-proportion targets; adds a shared-feature module and a target-focused proxy loss.
adaptation: Use as the DSRL variant for 0.19% crack pixels: weight SR/affinity on a dilated crack + gridline band only.
min_experiment: Second arm of the DSRL experiment; same baseline, metric and kill.
evidence: R: six public medical datasets in three scenarios; numbers not retrieved.
